title: Liquid AI's 2.6B model brings capable agents to phones and laptops
friendlyTitle: A small AI model can run useful agents on your device
summary: Liquid AI released LFM2.5-2.6B, a compact model trained for tool use and multi-step agent workflows. The company reports a 128K context window, memory use below 2.5 GB, and competitive agent performance against models roughly four times larger.
friendlySummary: Liquid AI made a small model for tools and multi-step tasks. It can run on laptops and some phones while using less than 2.5 GB of memory.
whyItMatters: Small, capable models can keep private data on-device, work without a constant cloud connection, and reduce inference bills. Developers should still validate the vendor-reported benchmarks against their own tasks, especially coding workloads where larger models retain an advantage.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This could make private, offline AI helpers cheaper and easier to use. Test it with your own work before depending on its benchmark claims.
